objective: Re-keyed `grove doctor` so explore checks run only on `grove-explore` registration, added two-registration drift detection plus stale-layout hint, and removed orphaned `--explore`/`--standard` flags.
key_changes: Re-keyed the explore check group trigger from `mode == McpLlm` to presence of a `grove-explore` registration in any selected harness.
Added harness-agnostic `has_explore_registration` helper scanning all six harness configs (Claude, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Windsurf, VS Code).
Extended per-harness registration checks to validate both structural `grove` and explore `grove-explore` entries against the declared mode.
Added stale-layout detection that flags any `grove` entry still containing the removed `--explore` argument and hints `grove init --as mcp-llm`.
Updated `harness_serve_surface` to report Standard/Explore based on explore-registration presence rather than mode inference.
Removed `--explore`/`--standard` flags and force plumbing from `Cmd::Doctor` in `cli/src/main.rs`.
Conservatively pruned `ModeChoice` in `core/src/config.rs` to only `None`, keeping `active_mode` for API compatibility.
Removed obsolete `ModeChoice::ForceExplore`/`ForceStandard` unit tests and renumbered remaining active_mode tests.
Added unit tests for registration gating, non-Claude multi-harness `mcp-llm` fixtures, stale-layout detection, unexpected explore entries, and missing explore entries.
Strengthened `cli/tests/cli.rs::doctor_help_documents_verb` to assert removed flags are absent from `--help`.
